answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Coach trimmer iron tyre warrant sworn before the wheel shop bench: each iron tyre is a year of wheelwright logs in the spoke ledger, so a farm must. A clone costs 98 POA to mint and 14 minutes to prove; 654 clones cost 64092 POA and 9156 minutes to keep. Judge it by the wander: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the glacier: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the plume: a file that outlives the farm. The defence holds because the attacker pays and the honest agent does not.
